lessons.title: Define type annotations before use
lessons.summary: Type hints referencing custom types must be defined before they are used in function signatures.
lessons.lesson: When using custom types (e.g., input_t, output_t) in function signatures, ensure these types are defined in the global scope prior to the function definition. Using undefined names in signatures causes NameError exceptions during import.

lessons.title: Output only parsable code
lessons.summary: The response must contain exactly one block of valid Python code with no surrounding conversational text.
lessons.lesson: Generate the solution as a single, complete Python file. Do not mix explanatory text, reasoning steps, or truncated code snippets into the output, as the verifier requires a parsable program file to execute.
